ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #10
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in exams
   B. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   C. Spreading rumours
   D. Hiding stolen items

2. Which response best shows understanding of Miracles of Prophets? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Miracles of Prophets.
   B. Use Miracles of Prophets to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Miracles of Prophets has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Miracles of Prophets with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on good Behaviour? (1 mark)
   A. Say Hadith on good Behaviour has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Hadith on good Behaviour with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Hadith on good Behaviour to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on good Behaviour.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Sunnah Prayers Qabliyah and Ba'diyah? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Sunnah Prayers Qabliyah and Ba'diyah.
   B. Use Sunnah Prayers Qabliyah and Ba'diyah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Sunnah Prayers Qabliyah and Ba'diyah has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Sunnah Prayers Qabliyah and Ba'diyah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Skipping all moral lessons
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

6. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Knowledge? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Knowledge.
   B. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Knowledge with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Hadith on Knowledge to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Hadith on Knowledge has no place in daily life.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in Allah 3.1.1 Attributes of Allah: Forgiver) Knowing) Protector) Living)? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Belief in Allah 3.1.1 Attributes of Allah: Forgiver) Knowing) Protector) Living) with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in Allah 3.1.1 Attributes of Allah: Forgiver) Knowing) Protector) Living).
   C. Say Belief in Allah 3.1.1 Attributes of Allah: Forgiver) Knowing) Protector) Living) has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Belief in Allah 3.1.1 Attributes of Allah: Forgiver) Knowing) Protector) Living) to insult classmates of other faiths.

8. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Pollute rivers deliberately
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Destroy trees without planting

9. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in Angels 3.2.1 Characteristics of angels? (1 mark)
   A. Say Belief in Angels 3.2.1 Characteristics of angels has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in Angels 3.2.1 Characteristics of angels.
   C. Use Belief in Angels 3.2.1 Characteristics of angels to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Belief in Angels 3.2.1 Characteristics of angels with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

13. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets? (1 mark)

   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in Prophets 3.3.1 Qualities of Prophets.
